description: Use when the user wants a site's icons or vector logos: inline SVGs as paste-ready markup plus external .svg file URLs. Not for: raster images (use extract_assets). If icons are mounted by JavaScript, call again with render=true (+5 credits).

fresh.description: Skip the 24-hour cache and re-extract the live page - use when the site just changed and a cached result would be stale. Charged normally; the fresh result replaces the cached copy.

render.description: Force a real browser so the page's JavaScript runs before it is read. Slower, and adds 5 credits. Usually not needed: when the plain read comes back as a JavaScript app shell or the site refuses it (401/403/406) or timed out, the server already re-runs the page in a browser by itself at no extra cost, and usage.autoRender says so. Pass it for images, videos or Lottie that only load on scroll, with screenshot=true, or when a result is still thin after that automatic pass. If a 403 says the browser was refused too, the site cannot be extracted - do not retry. extract_code always runs in a real browser at no extra cost, so render=true is not needed there (only together with screenshot=true). On extract_design_tokens, render=true only permits the browser: the plain read still runs first, and the 5 credits are charged only if the browser was actually needed.

screenshot.description: Requires render=true. Adds a screenshot field to the result: a public URL of a capture of the page (live 7 days), taken by the same browser that rendered it. Pass true for the 1440x900 viewport or 'full' for the entire page height. No extra credits beyond the render surcharge. Useful for showing the user what the extracted site looks like.

truncation_note.description: Present when the result was trimmed - says what was dropped and how to get more.

usage.description: Credit usage for the authed key (spent, remaining, monthly limit).
